verdict.rationale: The skill artifacts and their distribution can be self-hosted. Skills are plain filesystem folders under a published open standard (docs-64, docs-47, docs-67). Marketplaces can be served from your own git repos or local paths (docs-36, docs-9, docs-41). A hands-on probe installed an official skill with third-party tooling and no Anthropic account (probe-rt-1), and a developer ran an adapted, model-agnostic version on another model (comm-17). However, the runtime that executes skills is Claude Code or the Claude API, and API skills run in Anthropic's code-execution container (docs-10, docs-24), so the full stack is not self-hostable first-party. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted runtime or execution environment, an offline or local-model execution path, and first-party self-hosting docs.
